extraction.document_summary: AIA Around the World Plus (II) is a travel insurance plan from AIA that provides “enhanced protection” before, during, and after trips, including COVID-19-related coverage. It is “one-size-fits-all” and lets you select coverage options, with “three levels of protection” and either “a single trip or a year of unlimited travel”, plus “an individual or family plan.” Coverage areas can be selected as ASEAN, Asia, or worldwide. Two named plan types are shown: Premier Deluxe and Classic. For example, Travel Cancellation reimbursements are S$15,000 (Premier Deluxe) vs S$5,000 (Classic), and Medical Expenses Overseas are up to S$2,000,000 (Premier Deluxe) vs S$200,000 (Classic) for children. The brochure also states COVID-19 benefits are payable on an additional basis and “none of them offset the payment of any other benefits,” with limits that vary by age and plan.
quality_notes: The brochure provides a detailed benefits table with plan-specific sums for Premier Deluxe and Classic.
COVID-19 benefits are clearly separated in the table and include an additional-basis and no-offset note.
No explicit underwriting method, entry age limits, or coverage period length (days/months) is stated beyond “single trip” vs “a year of unlimited travel.”

Only generic references to exclusions are provided (e.g., pre-existing conditions, extreme sports, and “full list of exclusions” in the policy contract), without listing specific excluded circumstances.

policies.quick_summary: Travel insurance with coverage for trip cancellations/postponements/curtailment, travel delays, baggage and personal liability, accidental death/dismemberment schedule, overseas medical and evacuation, and COVID-19 benefits. Two plan types: Premier Deluxe and Classic, with plan-specific benefit limits shown in a comprehensive S$ benefits table. COVID-19 benefits are stated as payable on an additional basis and do not offset other benefits. Coverage can be for a single trip or unlimited travel for a year, and for ASEAN/Asia/worldwide areas of cover, with age bands affecting some limits (e.g., medical and evacuation).
coverage_scope: ASEAN: Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam
Asia: Australia, China, Hong Kong, India, Japan, Korea, Macau, Mongolia, New Zealand, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Timor-Leste and includes ASEAN
Trip coverage described as before you set off and until after you return home
policies.eligibility_notes: All ages covered, from 2 weeks up. Annual multiple trip terms are subject to the insured’s country of residence and trip timing (see caveat note for medical and no cover condition).
policies.coverage_term_description: Provides either “a single trip or a year of unlimited travel.”
important_caveats: COVID-19 benefits are payable on an additional basis and “none of them offset the payment of any other benefits.”
General notes state there are conditions (such as “pre-existing conditions and participation in extreme sports”) under which “no benefits will be payable.”

Follow-up medical limitation for medical expenses in Singapore/after return is subject to stated return-day windows (e.g., Complementary Medical Practitioner reimbursement “within 30 days of return” and Post-Trip Medical Expense “up to 45 days of return” is stated under evacuation context).

Single-trip medical expenses: If insured travels back to home country outside Singapore for a continuous period “more than 30 days,” only reimbursement for home country medical expenses up to “20% of the benefit amount specified in the selected plan.”

Annual multiple-trip plan: “There will be no cover if the insured’s country of residence is not Singapore and the loss, injury and/or sickness that occurs during the trip is in the insured’s home country or country of residence.”

AIA Around The World Plus (II) offers comprehensive benefits from before
you set off, to enhanced protection that lasts
until after you return home.

Three levels of protection – so you don’t have to pay for more
than you need
A single trip or a year of unlimited travel

review_notes: Only named base plan tiers (Premier Deluxe and Classic) are represented as plans; no separate marketed product names beyond these two are created.

COVID-19 Benefits are treated as part of the base policy benefits table (not as separate rider records) because the brochure does not label them as a rider/attachment; benefit_level is marked as optional within benefits only to distinguish them from non-COVID benefits in the brochure table context.

Some table rows show additional column values (e.g., 120,000 / 500,000) that are not explicitly labeled as a third plan in the excerpt; only Premier Deluxe and Classic are extracted as plan tiers per the brochure’s named plan columns. Where exact mapping is ambiguous, payout amounts are left null or marked low confidence.
